free_tier_limits: Free of charge for anyone; contact NLM if expected usage exceeds 50,000 calls/day.
rate_limits: Advised maximum 25 requests/second (soft; the enforced limit may be higher depending on system load). Handle X-RateLimit-Limit, Retry-After, and HTTP 503; notify NLM if regularly exceeding 50 requests/second.
resolution_notes: base_url: Corrected; official RxTerms docs identify the /search URL as the API Base URL: https://clinicaltables.nlm.nih.gov/apidoc/rxterms/v3/doc.html. free_tier_limits: Corrected; the FAQ says CTSS is free for anyone and requests contact above 50,000 calls/day: https://clinicaltables.nlm.nih.gov/faq.html. rate_limits: Corrected; the FAQ specifies a soft 25 requests/second advisory limit, relevant headers, possible HTTP 503, and notice above 50 requests/second: https://clinicaltables.nlm.nih.gov/faq.html.
